games.name: Brawl-Blox
games.desc:
October Season Theme: Fall
Premium Track Reward: Kabocha Fang and Gourd Fang

New Seasons with exclusive maps and rewards every month!

It's a fan-made game for fans and new players that want to discover this world. Adapted to fit roblox's unique 3D style - you can jump and climb walls!

All models, scripts, interface and animations were made by me. Based on and a tribute to the game "Brawl Stars", which belongs to Supercell, and can be downloaded on Google Play.

Latest Updates:
- pop-up info on how to obtain items from the catalog

- 2 Titles for each Brawler
- Ranks up to 100 and Prestige Tiers
- Seasonal Leaderboard
- More Controls Options
- Frank's 2nd Gadget: Irresistible Attraction
- New Season Track for August with a special Title at the end. Sprays, Music and Exclusive Skins on the Premium Track
- Shelly remodel
Full Update log is on our Server in Social Links

Check out our Server in Social Links, to suggest something, report bugs or just talk.

games.name: CITY-17
games.desc:
[RP] CITY-17 | Mark III
Welcome to the finest remaining urban center on Earth, City-17. Under the occupation of the Universal Union, dominated by the imposing Citadel, and surrounded by desolate wasteland, it's a site to behold.

Disclaimer:
1. This is a roleplay experience with a strict ruleset. Players are expected to understand and follow all systems in place. Join our communications server for more information.

2. This experience is resource-intensive. A stable, modern device is recommended, as performance may vary depending on your hardware and player count.

3. Some accounts will automatically be disqualified from this experience, due to security-measures against new/alternate accounts and cheaters.

> Remember to 👍 & ⭐ the game to support us!
> Make sure to join our communications server!
